Hey again!

Here is the full recording of Ye's massive and eventful concert at the Dinamo Arena in Tbilisi, Georgia, which took place yesterday, June 12, 2026. This was a legendary night for European fans, packed with exclusive details and unique live moments.

This rip comes directly from the official YouTube livestream. Please note that due to the original broadcast nature, there might be some minor lag segments.
